name: PG Maison
overview: PG Maison, developed by Pure Gold Real Estate Development, is an exclusive residential project ideally situated on Al Asayel Street in the vibrant Al Furjan area. This prime location offers residents the perfect blend of tranquility and accessibility, with convenient connections to key destinations like Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR). Al Furjan’s masterfully planned community features a mix of villas and apartment complexes, catering to diverse housing needs while providing a variety of architectural styles that combine Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs.
